title: sourcecontrolbranchconfiguration
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, sourcecontrolconfigurationid.

branchname.description: Name of the branch associated with the organization or solution

branchsyncedcommitid.description: Git commit id of the branch which was last synced in the organization

branchsyncedtime.description: Specifies the time at which branch was last synced in the organization

createdon.description: Date and time when the record was created.

importsequencenumber.description: Sequence number of the import that created this record.

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the record was modified.

overriddencreatedon.description: Date and time that the record was migrated.

rootfolderpath.description: Specifies the relative path of the folder under which the organization or solution changes would be synced

upstreambranchname.description: Stores the git upstream branch name associated with the organization

upstreambranchsyncedcommitid.description: Specifies the upstream branch commit id which was last synced to the current branch

upstreambranchsyncedtime.description: Specifies the time when the upstream branch was last synced to the current branch

_createdby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who created the record.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the record.

_modifiedby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who modified the record.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who modified the record.

_sourcecontrolconfigurationid_value.description: Unique identifier of source control configuration
